jobs.descriptionText:
The Senior Relationship Manager is a senior-level position responsible for assisting clients in raising funds in the capital markets, as well as in providing strategic advisory services for mergers, acquisitions and other types of financial transactions in coordination with the Institutional Banking team. The Senior Relationship Manager also serves as an intermediary in trading for clients. The overall objective of this role is to act as a strategic advisor to our clients by formulating investment strategies and raising capital for clients.
Responsibilities
Expand a portfolio of accounts with varying/complex financial needs with the objective of revenue growth and good credit quality in line with Citi’s credit standards, policies and processes
Identify customer needs and recommend solutions to address these needs, such as financing, streamlining of cash management operations, foreign currency solutions, etc.
Cross-sell banking products, including cash management, trade finance, trade services, structured trade products, foreign exchange, commodities, fixed income, loans (including syndicated, bilateral) and capital market products
Responsible for all credit aspects of the relationship including annual reviews, early problem recognition and remedial management
Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.
Qualifications
6-10 years of experience
Comprehensive knowledge of credit analytics and financial modelling
Proven expertise in Risk assessment and valuation
Education
Bachelor's degree/University degree or equivalent experience
Master's degree preferred

jobs.descriptionText:
Some Careers Have More Impact Than Others.
If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Associate Director, Software Engineering Specialist
.
Business: Group Functions Technology
Principal Responsibilities
Tech leadership & delivery ownership: Lead end-to-end engineering delivery for big data ETL and scoring pipelines, from design through build, testing, release, and operational support.
Architect scalable solutions on GCP: Design and evolve cloud-native architectures using GCP services (e.g., Dataproc/Spark, GCS, CloudSQL, GKE, VMs) aligned to non-functional requirements.
Build high-performance data pipelines: Develop and optimise Spark/Scala jobs for large-scale batch processing, data quality controls, enrichment, and feature/scoring outputs.
Integrate with Quantexa: Drive effective integration patterns and engineering standards around the Quantexa platform, ensuring robust data ingestion, entity resolution/analytics workflows, and downstream consumption.
Search & investigative enablement: Design and implement efficient indexing/retrieval patterns using Elastic Search to support investigative and analytical use cases.
Raise engineering standards: Establish best practices for code quality, CI/CD, testing strategies, observability, reliability, and cost/performance optimisation; mentor engineers and conduct technical reviews.
Requirements
Strong hands-on big data engineering background, with proven experience building production-grade ETL pipelines and data platforms at scale.
Advanced Spark + Scala experience (performance tuning, partitioning strategies, handling skew, optimising job execution, production support).
Strong GCP experience designing and running data workloads (e.g., Dataproc, GCS, CloudSQL, GKE/containers, IAM/security basics, networking considerations).
Technical leadership experience (solution design ownership, estimation/planning, guiding teams through delivery, mentoring, setting standards and direction).
Solid engineering fundamentals: distributed systems, data modelling, batch processing patterns, fault tolerance, testing and CI/CD discipline.
Stakeholder and communication strength: able to translate complex technical topics to non-technical partners, navigate a complex organisation, and drive outcomes across teams.
You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering - PE, Application Platforms
jobs.descriptionText:
Some careers have more impact than others.
If you’re looking for further opportunities to develop your career, take the next step in fulfilling your potential right here at HSBC.
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
Head of Engineering- PE, Application Platforms.
Business:CTO
Job ID：58472
The Opportunity
CTO Platform Engineering & Architecture (CTOp), within the CTO, builds next-gen application and AI platforms that cut toil through open-source and automated controls, so teams ship code (and containers) faster, safer and more reliably.
This hands-on Head of Engineering, Principal role leads Application Platform Engineering in partnership with the Head of Application Platforms, owning outcomes end-to-end from strategy and roadmap to transparent governance and predictable delivery.
You’ll combine big-picture platform architecture with hands-on implementation to drive ~80% migration to the standard platform and consolidate six hosting platforms into one resilient, well-controlled estate, strengthening observability, operational readiness and measurable engineering standards.
What You’ll Do
Leading the engineering function for Application Platform Engineering, covering strategic direction and day-to-day execution.
Supporting the Head of Application Platforms with end-to-end ownership of delivery, controls, and outcomes across the team.
Establishing and operating effective governance, including prioritisation, delivery cadence, and decision-making forums.
Defining, implementing, and tracking measurable engineering standards to improve quality, reliability, and consistency.
Driving the migration strategy and execution to achieve ~80% application migration onto the standard platform.
Leading the consolidation of six hosting platforms into a standard platform to reduce complexity and operational risk.
Improving platform resilience and time-to-market through standard patterns, reusable capabilities, and streamlined delivery.
Ensuring consistent observability practices (monitoring, logging, alerting) across the platform and migrated applications.
Implementing automated run controls to strengthen operational management and reduce manual intervention.
Managing delivery and control outcomes, ensuring transparency through metrics, reporting, and continuous improvement.
Partnering with stakeholders across technology and delivery to align priorities, manage dependencies, and remove blockers.
What You Will Need To Succeed In The Role
We are agnostic - focused on impact and outcomes: You may come with Java, Python, Node, C, C++, C# or any other coding language.
14+ years’ relevant senior engineering leadership experience in Platform Engineering and/or large-scale application hosting environments.
Proven track record delivering complex technology change across multiple teams, including platform consolidation and migration programmes.
Strong experience establishing governance, prioritisation, and delivery management practices in an engineering-led environment.
Demonstrable ability to define and embed engineering standards with measurable outcomes (e.g., reliability, quality, delivery performance).
Strong understanding of resilience engineering, operational risk management, and controls within enterprise technology environments.
Strong knowledge of observability practices and operating models (monitoring, logging, alerting, SLOs/SLAs, incident management).
Experience implementing automation for operational controls (e.g., automated runbooks, policy-as-code, standardised controls).
Ability to drive standardisation through consistent engineering patterns and reusable platform capabilities.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills across senior technology leadership and delivery partners.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate strategy into executable plans and clear outcomes.
Demonstrated leadership behaviours that build inclusive, high-performing teams, with clear accountability and a focus on delivery outcome.
Note that this is a hands-on role and will be a Principal Engineer, there will be an expectation that they deliver code through to production.
Ideally, you are capable of writing Linux kernel, know Kubernetes, understand networks from packets to TCP/UDP to service mesh.

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

  • Conduct product training to support and deliver new product launches and lead client education events to help client gain better knowledge of financial markets and financial solutions.
  • Follow the needs-based sales process, give clients a meaningful and consistent wealth experience and ultimately provide an outstanding client experience
  • Support RMs to gain more client trust and commitment in broadening and deepening their relationship with HSBC, and increase the effectiveness and quality of needs fulfilled for target clients
  • Strengthen HSBC’s image as a leading wealth provider by providing clients with access to advanced technical product expertise
  • Conduct portfolio reviews with RMs, assess product suitability and market and regulatory change impact to products held by clients as appropriate, identify opportunities and manage risks
  • Join RMs in meeting clients and provide advice, input based on technical knowledge while acting as a second point of contact to RMs for specific products and solutions

  • Demonstrated ability and experience to correctly identify client needs
  • Solid skills to manage consultative sales process
  • A solid understanding of global Anti-money Laundering standards
  • Team player with collaborative skills
  • Knowledge of local and Group compliance regulation

Job Summary

The Software Engineer - Distributed Systems designs, builds, and supports highly scalable, resilient, and secure services for critical transaction processing environments. The role focuses on solving complex engineering problems across service orchestration, data consistency, failure recovery, observability, and performance at scale, delivering robust, high-throughput, low-latency critical banking systems. The engineer will be part of a high-performing team focused on engineering excellence and delivery quality. Experience with Go or Java is required. Experience with durable execution platforms such as Temporal, DBOS, or similar frameworks is a strong bonus.
Key Responsibilities
Strategy
Help shape the engineering direction for critical, high-availability distributed systems.
Contribute to long-term thinking around scalability, resilience, maintainability, and platform evolution.
Identify opportunities to simplify complex workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve delivery speed.
Support adoption of better engineering practices, including automation, reusable patterns, and AI-assisted development where it adds value.
Think beyond immediate implementation to ensure solutions are robust, future-ready, and aligned with evolving business needs.
Bring structured problem-solving and strong critical thinking to ambiguous technical challenges.
Promote engineering excellence, code quality, and operational discipline.
Contribute to documentation, technical reviews, and continuous improvement activities.
Undertake additional responsibilities as assigned within the scope of the role.
Apply secure engineering practices in line with internal governance and compliance expectations.
Build solutions that support integrity, reliability, traceability, and controlled operational behaviour.
Business
Design and build distributed backend services for high-volume transaction processing.
Develop scalable, fault-tolerant solutions for transaction-heavy systems.
Implement resilient integration patterns across APIs, queues, streaming platforms, and internal services.
Build strong validation, integrity, idempotency, and recovery mechanisms to support safe and consistent processing.
Deliver solutions that improve availability, consistency, and operational resilience.
Translate business and operational needs into well-structured technical implementations.
People & Talent
Collaborate effectively with engineering peers and contribute to a positive, high-performance team culture.
Share knowledge, learn continuously, and support skill development through strong technical contribution and example.
Demonstrate self-driven ownership, curiosity, and a strong can-do attitude.
Work constructively with others to solve hard technical problems and deliver against commitments.
Governance
Follow engineering standards, design principles, and delivery practices that support safe and reliable execution.
Apply disciplined software development practices, including testing, code quality, and maintainability.
Support the use of AI development tools responsibly through sound engineering judgement and hardening practices.
Maintain clear decision-making, traceability, and accountability in technical delivery.
Regulatory & Business Conduct
Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
Key stakeholders
Work with product, platform, engineering, and delivery stakeholders to ensure solutions meet technical and operational needs.
Engage with relevant technical partners to align on implementation approach, dependencies, and delivery outcomes.
Communicate clearly on progress, risks, and technical decisions.
Build effective working relationships across teams to support delivery of complex engineering outcomes.
Other Responsibilities
Embrace and practise SCB’s brand promise of Here for Good and corporate values
Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures
Responsible for building a culture of good conduct
Our Ideal Candidate
10+ years’ experience in Strong software engineering background with hands-on experience in Go or Java.
Proven experience designing and building distributed systems or high-availability backend services.
Strong software architecture experience, with the ability to design scalable, resilient, and maintainable distributed systems.
Solid knowledge of software design patterns and the ability to apply them effectively in real-world engineering solutions.
Solid understanding of concurrency, service-to-service communication, and failure handling.
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency, and resilient system design.
Familiarity with transactional consistency, idempotency, retries, and recovery patterns.
Experience working in environments with strict reliability, observability, and operational requirements.
Experience working on critical financial or transaction-intensive systems is highly desirable.
Experience with durable execution frameworks (for example Temporal, DBOS, or similar) is a strong bonus.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools and workflows.
Experience with AI hardening design, including safe, reliable, and controlled use of AI in engineering workflows.
Self-driven, curious, and optimistic with a strong can-do attitude.
Good communication skills and a collaborative engineering mindset.
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Role Specific Technical Competencies
Software Engineering
Software Development
Application Design, Architecture
About Standard Chartered
We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.
Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.
Together We
Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term
What We Offer
In line with our Fair Pay Charter,
we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.
Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
